summary: Receives Open Sound Control packets, parses messages or bundles into FIFO table rows, and can run a callback for each received OSC packet or message.

key_params.name: active
key_params.note: Enable listening on the network port; incoming data is lost while off

key_params.name: protocol
key_params.note: Use UDP messaging, multicast UDP, or reliable UDT-style messaging

key_params.name: address
key_params.note: Multicast listen address or UDT server address

key_params.name: port
key_params.note: Network port that OSC In accepts packets on

key_params.name: localaddress
key_params.note: Local network interface address for multi-NIC systems

key_params.name: shared
key_params.note: Share a connection with other networking DATs using the same protocol

key_params.name: addscope
key_params.note: Filter OSC address names by TouchDesigner pattern syntax

key_params.name: typetag
key_params.note: Include OSC argument type tags in output rows

key_params.name: splitbundle
key_params.note: Split bundle contents into one row per contained message

key_params.name: splitmessage
key_params.note: Split OSC address and arguments into separate columns

key_params.name: bundletimestamp
key_params.note: Include bundle timestamp values as a column

key_params.name: callbacks
key_params.note: Callback DAT executed once per received message

key_params.name: executeloc
key_params.note: Choose where callback scripts execute from

key_params.name: fromop
key_params.note: Operator context used when Execute From is set to Specified Operator

key_params.name: clamp
key_params.note: Limit FIFO output to a bounded number of messages

key_params.name: maxlines
key_params.note: Maximum retained message rows when Clamp Output is on

key_params.name: clear
key_params.note: Clear all logged rows except the heading

key_params.name: bytes
key_params.note: Output raw OSC packet bytes in a separate column

key_params.name: customext
key_params.note: Custom editor extension when Extension is set to Custom Extension

key_params.name: extension
key_params.note: Edit/view file extension exposed to external editors

key_params.name: language
key_params.note: Common DAT script-language selection

key_params.name: wordwrap
key_params.note: Common DAT node-display word wrap setting

common_gotchas: The table is FIFO and defaults to a limited line count, so long captures need Max Lines or no clamp.
Bundles can stay as single rows or split into per-message rows; downstream schemas must match the Split Bundle setting.
Blob, MIDI, RGBA, and unknown argument types are serialized into readable text or byte lists rather than native binary objects.
Windows firewall can block OSC traffic even when the DAT parameters are correct.
key_concepts: Receives OSC messages and bundles into a DAT table.
Protocol, address, port, local address, and shared options define socket binding.
Scope, type-tag, bundle, message, and timestamp options control parsed OSC output shape.
Callbacks and FIFO retention controls manage received-message scripts and table size.
